custom_logic_notes: The core entry/exit logic is fully encapsulated in the CBC_WS_RSI custom signal class from ACBC_WS_RSI.mqh. The CExpertSignal framework uses a voting system: each filter returns a 0-100 strength value, multiplied by Weight (1.0), then compared against ThresholdOpen (40) to open and ThresholdClose (20) to close. SL/TP are both 0 meaning the EA relies entirely on signal reversal for exits. Expert_EveryTick=false means signals are evaluated once per bar, not every tick. The exact RSI vs MA crossover/comparison logic inside CBC_WS_RSI::LongCondition() and CBC_WS_RSI::ShortCondition() requires reading the .mqh file.
python_conversion_notes: Must read ACBC_WS_RSI.mqh to extract the actual LongCondition/ShortCondition logic. The CExpert framework's threshold voting system (0-100 signal strength * weight vs threshold) needs to be reimplemented. Since SL/TP are 0, exit logic depends entirely on the reverse signal exceeding ThresholdClose=20. Position sizing is straightforward fixed lot. No trailing stop logic needed. New-bar guard is implicit from EveryTick=false.
